title: Raw localization and four-field coherence of integral scalar comparisons
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. For every finite $F\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $\mathcal I_F^s(T)$ and $\mathcal I_F^p(T)$ be the framework and PBC integral full categories underlying [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $I_F$ be their exact integral identity identification, as in [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. Put $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,T}$, and for $E\subseteq L$ write $C_{L/E}(K)=K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L$ for ordinary derived extension and $U_{L/E}$ for the strict quotient-tower extension [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Integral formulas below are written in the common full categories using $I_F$.
Write $\mathcal C_F^s=\mathcal I_F^s(T)[1/\varpi_F]$ and $\mathcal C_F^p=\mathcal I_F^p(T)[1/\varpi_F]$ for the raw rationalizations, $Q_F$ for integral localization, and $J_F$ for the exact raw rationalization of $I_F$, fixing objects and tensor morphisms $u\otimes e$. Write $S_{L/E}$ and $P_{L/E}$ for the framework and PBC rational scalar extensions and $a^s,a^p$ for their specified associators [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].
Let $A^C_{M,L,E}:C_{M/L}C_{L/E}\to C_{M/E}$ and $A^U_{M,L,E}:U_{M/L}U_{L/E}\to U_{M/E}$ be the ordinary and specified completed integral associators. Suppose $b_{L/E}:C_{L/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}U_{L/E}$ is an exact integral natural isomorphism with the actual quotient-map lift, commuting with specified shifts. Suppose ordinary transport fixes tensor generators, $A^C,A^U$ rationalize to these specified associators, both integral scalar systems satisfy the associator pentagon and unit laws, and
$$A^C_K C_{M/L}(b_{L/E,K}^{-1})b_{M/L,U_{L/E}K}^{-1}=b_{M/E,K}^{-1}A^U_K$$
including the multiplication/completeness unit substitutions. Assume $b_{E/E}$ is the completeness unit after multiplication. Then localization over the final field gives exact natural isomorphisms
$$j_{L/E}=Q_L(b_{L/E}^{-1}):J_L S_{L/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{L/E}J_E,$$
commuting with the specified shifts, retaining the specified integral lift, with the normalized identity-extension value and both unit equations, and satisfying
$$a^p_{M,L,E}P_{M/L}(j_{L/E})j_{M/L,S_{L/E}K}=j_{M/E}J_M(a^s_{M,L,E}).$$
More precisely, for $E_0\subseteq E_1\subseteq E_2\subseteq E_3$ abbreviate $S_{ba}=S_{E_b/E_a}$, $P_{ba}=P_{E_b/E_a}$, $J_b=J_{E_b}$ and $j_{ba}=j_{E_b/E_a}$. The comparison
$$D=(P_{32}P_{21}j_{10})(P_{32}j_{21}S_{10})(j_{32}S_{21}S_{10})$$
from $J_3S_{32}S_{21}S_{10}$ to $P_{32}P_{21}P_{10}J_0$ has its two associator contractions equal respectively to
$$j_{30}J_3\bigl(a^s_{3,2,0}S_{32}(a^s_{2,1,0})\bigr),\qquad
j_{30}J_3\bigl(a^s_{3,1,0}(a^s_{3,2,1}S_{10})\bigr).$$
These are equal and give the four-field compatibility for the specified comparisons and associators. All unit degeneracies, including repeated fields, are included.

proof.text:
Write composition right to left, suppress the common object $K$, and set $B_L=a^p_{3,2,0}\,P_{32}(a^p_{2,1,0})J_0$. This is the first contraction from $P_{32}P_{21}P_{10}J_0$ to $P_{30}J_0$. Substitution of Step 2 for $(2,1,0)$ into the displayed $D$ gives
$$B_LD=a^p_{3,2,0}\,P_{32}(j_{20})\,P_{32}J_2(a^s_{2,1,0})\,(j_{32}S_{21}S_{10}).$$
Naturality of $j_{32}$ at the arrow $a^s_{2,1,0,K}:S_{21}S_{10}K\to S_{20}K$ replaces the last two factors by $(j_{32}S_{20})\,J_3S_{32}(a^s_{2,1,0})$. Step 2 for $(3,2,0)$ now gives
$$B_LD=j_{30}\,J_3\bigl(a^s_{3,2,0}\,S_{32}(a^s_{2,1,0})\bigr).$$
These are substitutions in the already established cocycle and one naturality square; only associativity of arrow composition and the functor laws are used.

proof.text:
For the other contraction put $B_R=a^p_{3,1,0}\,(a^p_{3,2,1}P_{10}J_0)$. Naturality of $a^p_{3,2,1}:P_{32}P_{21}\to P_{31}$ at the arrow $j_{10,K}:J_1S_{10}K\to P_{10}J_0K$ gives
$$(a^p_{3,2,1}P_{10}J_0)(P_{32}P_{21}j_{10})=(P_{31}j_{10})(a^p_{3,2,1}J_1S_{10}).$$
Substitute this equality in $B_RD$, then apply Step 2 for $(3,2,1)$ at $S_{10}K$. The result is
$$B_RD=a^p_{3,1,0}(P_{31}j_{10})(j_{31}S_{10})J_3(a^s_{3,2,1}S_{10}).$$
Step 2 for $(3,1,0)$ and the functor composition law reduce this to
$$B_RD=j_{30}J_3\bigl(a^s_{3,1,0}(a^s_{3,2,1}S_{10})\bigr).$$
This uses only the written naturality square and substitutions of the earlier three-field equation.

proof.text: The published GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.associator_cocycle of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] equates leftContraction with rightContraction of [def-fd-raw-localization-scalar-data]. Apply J_N to this equality and compose with the common j for the total inclusion. Proof irrelevance identifies the two parenthesizations of that inclusion. Together with the two already proved contraction formulas, this is the final clause. No PBC pentagon is needed for this equality. All inclusions are non-strict, so the same naturality and cocycle calculations include every repeated-field and unit degeneracy.
